name: print-social-travel-days-posts-peach-gradient-with-italic-serif
title: 'Travel Days' pack with peach gradients, circle photos and large italic serif phrases
whatItIs: Nine square posts on peach-to-cream gradients with orange circles behind circle-cropped travel photos, big orange italic serif phrases ('Let the journey heal your soul', 'Explore, dream, and find your escape') and a plane logo.
whatItMeans: Dreamy and soothing; soft gradients and italic serif make travel feel restorative.
techniques: Use soft warm gradients as the whole palette.
Let a large italic serif carry the message.
Crop photos in circles with a colour circle behind.

vocabulary.definition: A slanted serif typeface with an elegant feel.
A gentle colour blend with low contrast.
